messages:
Nora Blake: FYI we got a lead for Zephyr Inc via our AWS marketplace listing and separately from SI partner Nimbus. Last time this slipped through the cracks. Can we lock down a compact routing rule? @Ethan @Sofia

Ethan Yu: Short answer: yes. We should implement a deterministic default + claim window. Default: marketplace wins, but SI can claim with allowed proof within 36h. If SI claim arrives after 36h, AE keeps it.

Sofia Martinez: Allowed proofs list suggestion: marketplace_order_id, signed_engagement_email, calendar invite with meeting subject containing account name, or partner-scope ticket id. Also require partner org id to match Nimbus' partner ID in our registry.

Devon Clark: CRM note: add fields lead_source_detail, partner_org_id, marketplace_txn_id. Webhook will evaluate these and emit recommended_owner. If recommended_owner != crm_owner, create an internal claim thread in #partnerships-claims with the summary.

Nora Blake: What about territory splits? If SI is EMEA-only and marketplace lead is global, we should be able to split ownership by region. Proposal: if partner_claim_region != lead_region, create split record and assign per-region AE/partner owners.

Ethan Yu: Good call. Also protect against stale SI claims: if SI claim proof references a draft MOU (not signed), mark as provisional and require signed doc in 14 days or revert.

Sofia Martinez: For high ACV (>300k) add a 14-day exec-engagement SLA: SI must name an exec sponsor or AE reclaims and we schedule a joint exec intro.

partner-bot: Created ticket PRT-6021 "Implement SI claim webhook + split-region support" and linked this thread. Assigned to @Devon.

Devon Clark: Action items: I'll implement webhook skeleton, create the claim thread format, and add the CRM fields. Sofia  can you draft the partner email template for claims? Nora  I'll need partner ID mapping from you.

Nora Blake: Will export partner registry and DM Devon. Also will draft Confluence shortplay by EOD Fri.

Ethan Yu: Draft policy JSON for engineers: {"priority": ["marketplace","si-intro","direct-sdr"], "si_claim_window_hours": 36, "allowed_proofs": ["marketplace_order_id","signed_engagement_email","meeting_ics","partner_scope_ticket"], "high_acv_threshold": 300000, "exec_engagement_days": 14}

Sofia Martinez: I'll post the email template to #partnerships-docs. Template will require subject: "SI CLAIM - <account> - <partner_id>" and attach one allowed proof.

Nora Blake: Thanks all. Goal: fewer mid-deal surprises and faster sales motions. We'll reconvene after the webhook POC. :rocket:
